mapper.select: SELECT e.series_id, e.user_id, e.series_group_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM series e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'SERIES' AND t.target_id = e.series_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.series_id

SELECT e.series_id, e.user_id, e.series_group_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM series e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'SERIES' AND t.target_id = e.series_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.series_id = #{seriesId}

SELECT e.series_id, e.user_id, e.series_group_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM series e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'SERIES' AND t.target_id = e.series_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.series_group_id = #{seriesGroupId} AND e.name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO series (user_id, series_group_id, name, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{seriesGroupId}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE series SET name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND series_id = #{seriesId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM series WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND series_id = #{seriesId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.series_id FROM series c JOIN series_group p ON p.series_group_id = c.series_group_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.name = #{defaultName} AND c.name = #{defaultName}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM figure_series_map WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND series_id = #{seriesId}
